core_modifications: None; git status showed only untracked install/configs/machines/cga_studio_5160.toml.
machine: IBM 5160, non-turbo 8088, CGA, GLaBIOS 0.2.6 XT, normal DRAM refresh simulation; monitor emulation enabled; ROM patches and title hacks disabled.
scope: Unmodified emulator-core measurements. No physical hardware validation; the exposed PIT settings and entry perturbations are a finite startup sample. OUT positions are instruction boundaries, not separately instrumented hardware register-latch times. Exact RGBI output is measured independently from every completed visible graphics frame.

run_methods.picard_injection: Four fresh machine instances; ROM runs for 20,000,000 cycles, COM loaded at 1000:0100, then 30,000,000 cycles.
run_methods.independent_calibration: Eight entry NOP counts (0,1,2,3,7,13,31,127), each with all four PIT phases; 11,000,000 cycles after injection. Four VRAM indices on alternating rows, independently computed per-row palette values, and explicit last-row-to-first-row leading-palette carry.
run_methods.disk: Four cold boots of the actual final 360 KiB DOS image, one for each PIT phase, each run for 400,000,000 CPU cycles. Normal DOS/AUTOEXEC loads the COM at 0C60:0100; no program injection.

dos_return.observed: Phases 0 and 3 screenshots visually reviewed: IMGLCK finished, instructions to run IMGLCK or REGLOCK, A:\> prompt. All four runs end in text mode after exactly 3,600 full kernel passes; no emulator errors.
dos_return.why_3599_frames: The 3,600th full raster pass is followed by cleanup before another completed graphics frame is presented. All 3,599 completed visible graphics frames per boot are compared, including the first.
